value.description: A meaningful established fact, never an empty or punctuation-only placeholder. Omit unknown facts from the list.
value.title: Value

unrestricted_choice.description: For a budget question, a separate explicit no-ceiling choice; otherwise null. Included in the displayed choices.

branches.description: Relevant title/choices for every exact choice ID of one earlier question. Empty if independent or for unknown typed answers.
branches.title: Branches

unrestricted_choice.description: For a budget question, a separate explicit no-ceiling choice; otherwise null. Included in the displayed choices.

label.description: Complete answer. Spending maximum: ceiling with billing period or explicitly unlimited, never a lower bound.
label.title: Label

value.description: Same full meaning as label: ceiling/absence and billing period. Keep choices distinct.
value.title: Value

RequestUnderstanding.description: Required semantic contract for live routing, independent of legacy scores.

intent.description: Communicative purpose, separate from whether clarification is needed.
intent.title: Intent

ambiguity_level.description: Unresolved meaning; not an action threshold.
ambiguity_level.title: Ambiguity Level

target_items.description: Equipment actually requested or referred to; resolve only supported references.
target_items.title: Target Items

categories.description: Conceptual equipment categories, without a fixed catalog taxonomy.
categories.title: Categories

budget_max.description: Explicit maximum budget; null when absent or units cannot be interpreted.
budget_max.title: Budget Max

budget_unit.description: User-established billing period. When semantically identical to a supplied catalog period, use that exact catalog unit string rather than translating/abbreviating it. Preserve unsupported periods; null only when unknown. Never infer a user period from prices.
budget_unit.title: Budget Unit

intended_use.description: Relevant user-stated workload, after corrections; null if unknown.
intended_use.title: Intended Use

missing_slots.description: Only material unknown requirements for the requested operation, not optional preferences.
missing_slots.title: Missing Slots

needs_external_search.description: Whether technical facts need external verification; shop prices, stock and policies need their authoritative source.
needs_external_search.title: Needs External Search

search_query.description: Focused technical verification query, or null when unnecessary.
search_query.title: Search Query

catalog_operation.description: Selection recommends equipment for a need; inspection answers properties of referred equipment; comparison contrasts equipment; none needs no catalog evidence. Independent of intent.
catalog_operation.title: Catalog Operation

additional_goals.description: Additional independently requested purposes from the actual user, separate from equipment requirements. A catalog operation with app topics requires a separately requested app explanation here. Available knowledge topics and rental preferences do not create additional app goals.
additional_goals.title: Additional Goals

reference_resolution.description: Supported current referent, or absence of prior referent. Nonempty.
reference_resolution.title: Reference Resolution

decision_reason.description: Nonempty evidenced reason to answer or ask material pending questions.
decision_reason.title: Decision Reason

RequestUnderstanding.title: RequestUnderstanding

speaker_register.description: Exact machine label. Use natural ungendered Thai in all assistant text.
speaker_register.title: Speaker Register

response_mode.description: Select the CURRENT response stage, independent of the eventual catalog operation: clarification whenever any material question is pending; conversation only for a nonfactual social reply with no questions; documents for approved app answers without questions; catalog_overview for unfiltered category browsing; equipment for a ready catalog answer; technical for ready external verification. Clarification includes a brief introduction and stops evidence synthesis, even when a selection/inspection/comparison operation remains requested.
response_mode.title: Response Mode

evidence_goal.description: For equipment/technical stages, the complete equipment task still to answer, preserving every requested property, comparison and constraint. Exclude app information answered separately by knowledge_ids/unverified_topic_ids. Null for other stages.
evidence_goal.title: Evidence Goal

knowledge_ids.description: Only supplied approved articles needed for information the user actually requested. Source availability is not a request to describe the platform; omit unrelated articles from a rental preference dialogue.
knowledge_ids.title: Knowledge Ids

unverified_topic_ids.description: Only unverified information topics actually asked about. Unknown platform information is unrelated to missing rental preferences or inventory evidence.
unverified_topic_ids.title: Unverified Topic Ids

message.description: Only a brief questionnaire introduction or nonfactual social reply, otherwise empty. Friendly natural Thai in a nongendered speaker voice: omit gender-associated first-person pronouns and sentence-final honorifics; express courtesy through helpful wording.
message.title: Message
